mapper.select: SELECT TOOL_NAME FROM TOOL_INFO WHERE TOOL_CODE = #{toolCode}
SELECT USERNAME FROM USER_INFO WHERE USERID = #{userId}

SELECT ID, TOOL_CODE, USER_ID, BORROW_TIME, RETURN_TIME, STATUS, OPERATOR_TYPE FROM BORROW_RECORD WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY BORROW_TIME DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT br.ID, br.TOOL_CODE, t.TOOL_NAME, t.CABINET_NO, br.USER_ID, u.USERNAME, br.BORROW_TIME, br.RETURN_TIME, br.STATUS, br.OPERATOR_TYPE, CASE br.STATUS WHEN 'BORROWED' THEN '已借出' WHEN 'RETURNED' THEN '已归还' WHEN 'OVERDUE' THEN '已逾期' ELSE br.STATUS END AS STATUS_NAME FROM BORROW_RECORD br LEFT JOIN TOOL_INFO t ON br.TOOL_CODE = t.TOOL_CODE LEFT JOIN USER_INFO u ON br.USER_ID = u.USERID WHERE br.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY br.BORROW_TIME DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BORROW_RECORD (ID, TOOL_CODE, USER_ID, BORROW_TIME, STATUS, OPERATOR_TYPE) VALUES (BORROW_RECORD_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{toolCode}, #{userId}, SYSDATE, 'BORROWED', #{operatorType})
mapper.update: UPDATE BORROW_RECORD SET RETURN_TIME = SYSDATE, STATUS = 'RETURNED' WHERE TOOL_CODE = #{toolCode} AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'BORROWED'
mapper.select: SELECT ID, TOOL_CODE, USER_ID, BORROW_TIME, RETURN_TIME, STATUS, OPERATOR_TYPE FROM BORROW_RECORD WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'BORROWED' ORDER BY BORROW_TIME DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BORROW_RECORD WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'BORROWED'
